title: create-enum-helper
summary: Generates a Byte-family record helper (ToByte/FromByte/ToInteger/ FromInteger/ToString/FromString) for an enum type
intro: Read this when you have an enum and want the usual conversion helpers without writing them by hand. create-enum-helper generates a Byte-family record helper with ToByte, FromByte, ToInteger, FromInteger, ToString and FromString; it is a preview unless you pass --apply.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH] - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
help: drag-lint create-enum-helper --qname <TEnum> [--apply|--json|--no-backup] [--methods <csv>] [--tostring rtti|case] [--db PATH]  - generate a Byte-family record helper for an enum
--methods tobyte,frombyte,tointeger,frominteger,tostring,fromstring (default: all 6); --tostring rtti (default, RTTI GetEnumName) or case (explicit case statement)
idempotent: a helper for the enum already indexed anywhere -> action=exists, no edit

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > Enum Record Helper (symbol)...
